findings.title: Public `findMany` removed and condition types changed without migrating callers
findings.body: `InsightsBookingService.findMany(findManyArgs)` was removed and replaced with `getBaseConditions()`, which returns a `Prisma.Sql` fragment. The return types of `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` also changed from `BookingTimeStatusDenormalizedWhereInput` to `Prisma.Sql`. The PR touches no other file. Any existing code that calls `findMany`, or that spreads these conditions into a Prisma `where`/`AND` clause, will fail to compile. If it is cast loosely, it will silently pass a `Sql` object as a where input at runtime. Either keep a compatible method or update every call site (insights tRPC handlers, etc.) in the same change.

findings.title: Caching tests deleted rather than ported
findings.body: The whole "Caching" describe block was removed, which verified that `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` return memoized results. The caching logic is still in the service (`cachedAuthConditions`, `cachedFilterConditions`) and was retyped in this PR. Nothing now checks that the memoization still works, for example that a `null` filter result is cached and not rebuilt on each call. These tests could have been ported to `Prisma.sql` expectations instead.
